designIntent.purpose: Teach naming, inspecting and reusing a meaningful page version.
keep: Keep actual interface pixels, source attribution and the demonstrated behavior.
Keep stable page identity, editable objects and the correct author watermark.
designIntent.requestedChange: Teach an actionable Editor workflow through clear pictures and a focused narrative.
